text_markup: Abilities can place credits on cards, as discussed in {ref:sec_host}. Credits on a player's card are not in that player's credit pool; the player can only interact with those credits as instructed by card abilities.
text_plain: Abilities can place credits on cards, as discussed in section 1.13. Credits on a player's card are not in that player's credit pool; the player can only interact with those credits as instructed by card abilities.
